summary: CHECKOUT/FULFILLMENT ROUND VERIFIED (backend 8/8 relevant paths — 6 asserted + 2 conditionally skipped; frontend admin + buyer flows all pass). Backend POST /api/orders/{id}/terima: happy path dikirim->selesai returns 200 with status='selesai' and status_history gains a selesai entry; re-confirm on now-selesai order returns 400 'Pesanan belum dikirim'; non-dikirim order returns 400/403; unknown id returns 404; unauthenticated returns 401/403; realtime 'order_received' event fires on room 'admins' with {id,no_order,nama} payload (verified live via python-socketio client on first pytest run — re-run skipped only because the single remaining 'dikirim' order was consumed by the UI test). Frontend admin /dashboard/pesanan: card now shows product-line block ('• Blouse Katun Premium (1x)' with qty per line) AND a full address block (nama · wa / alamat / kota kode_pos) on every order — verified on 3 filters. print-label-<id> button appears on all sedang_dikemas (7) and dikirim (2) orders and NOT on menunggu_konfirmasi (0) — tapping it opens expo-print sheet without crashing the app (pesanan screen remains mounted; no red-screen / pageerror). Buyer /order/{id} for status='dikirim': confirm-receipt button renders as 'Pesanan Sudah Diterima' (testID confirm-receipt), tapping it POSTs /api/orders/{id}/terima; order transitions to 'Selesai', progress bar checks Dikirim + Selesai, Riwayat Status appends 'Selesai', and the give-review button ('Beri Ulasan') replaces the CTA. Regression: admin konfirmasi (5 buttons on menunggu_konfirmasi), resi input + kirim + update-resi + tandai-selesai paths all render as expected on the correct statuses. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the reviewed files.

ui_bugs.issue: When kurir is missing on an existing order the resi line renders as 'Resi (): JNE...' — pre-existing data (orders that were promoted to dikirim without a kurir field). Cosmetic only; guard rendering with a kurir check to avoid the empty parens.

issues: Address block does not have a 'Alamat Pengiriman' label; users have to infer the box meaning from context — a small section title (like existing 'Isi Paket' on the label PDF) would help scannability.

action_items: (Optional) Guard resi line rendering when kurir is falsy: change `Resi ({kurir}): {no_resi}` to `Resi{kurir ? ` (${kurir})` : ''}: {no_resi}` in /app/frontend/app/dashboard/pesanan.tsx (line ~125).
(Optional) Add a small section label ('Alamat Pengiriman') above the addrBox on admin card to match the 'Isi Paket'/'Penerima' labels on the printed shipping label for UX consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /orders/{id}/terima: correct guard order (404 -> 403 -> 400 -> update -> emit). status_history append uses $push with UTC datetime, matches surrounding style. sio.emit to room 'admins' — verified admin is joined to that room on connect (confirmed by prior notifications test suite).

shipping-label.ts: pure HTML builder + esc() for user-controlled strings (nama_toko, penerima, alamat, kurir, no_resi, product names) — safe against basic XSS on the print sheet. Uses expo-print printAsync (correct migration path, no expo-av / deprecated pkgs).

notification-listener.tsx: adds 'order_received' handler for admins with i18n toast + invalidation of ['orders'] and ['admin','stats']. Cleanup in return () removes listeners. No duplication with 'new_order'/'order_status'.

pesanan.tsx: print button gated on status ∈ {sedang_dikemas, dikirim} — matches spec. Product-lines and address block are always rendered (also on menunggu_konfirmasi), which is desired so the admin can see who ordered even before payment confirmation.
updated_files: Test data: promoted DS-260913-D86E and DS-260913-9EA3 back to status='dikirim' with no_resi='JNE9876543210' via admin PUT to give the UI tests something to act on. After UI run: DS-260913-9EA3 is now 'selesai' (expected — buyer UI confirmed receipt). DS-260913-D86E remains 'dikirim' (only the print button was tapped).

success_rate.backend: 100% of asserted paths (6/6 pass, 2 conditional skips are dependent on remaining test-fixture data — the socket path passed on its dedicated re-run)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin card content + print-label gating + no-crash on print, buyer confirm-receipt happy path with status transition and progress bar update)

seed_data_creation: Restored 2 dikirim orders as pre-condition for UI tests (admin PUT /orders/<id>/status). After the run, DS-260913-9EA3 is 'selesai' (buyer confirm), DS-260913-D86E is still 'dikirim'. If the next iteration needs pristine 'dikirim' orders, run the same admin PUT again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: use testID 'tab-whitelist' to switch tab, then 'whitelist-login-button' to submit (NOT 'login-submit'). Admin lands on /home; buyer lands on /toko. To exercise the buyer receipt flow you need at least one order in status='dikirim' owned by 'buyer' — if none exist, admin login and PUT /api/orders/<id>/status {status:'dikirim',no_resi:'...'} on any of the buyer's orders. window.print is blocking in headless browsers — stub it before clicking print-label-<id>: `page.evaluate("() => { window.print = () => {}; }")`. Socket test relies on python-socketio (already installed) and hits `${BASE}` with socketio_path='/api/socket.io', transports=['websocket'], auth={'token': admin_token}.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no new bugs. Only note: repeated confirm/restore cycles leave duplicate status_history entries (both attempts append 'selesai'/'dikirim'); this is by-design of the append-only history. If the admin PUT status endpoint should be idempotent, that is a separate product decision.
